processing: A clone rather than a tea style, propagated from cuttings. Its leaf is processed as other Darjeeling usually is, most often as black tea.
harvest_season: As with other Darjeeling plantings, picked through the spring, summer, monsoon and autumn flushes; no season is specifically documented as its best.
appearance_dry: No description specific to this clone is documented; expect twisted Darjeeling leaf in green and brown.
appearance_liquor: Typical of Darjeeling, pale gold in spring to amber in summer.
appearance_wet: Typical of Darjeeling, a mix of green and coppery leaf.
taste_profile: No reliable tasting notes exist for this clone by name. Darjeeling black teas in general run from floral in spring to fruity in summer.

brewing.notes: General Darjeeling Western-style starting point, as nothing specific is recorded for this clone.

vintage_note: Rarely sold under its own name; it usually disappears into estate lots. Darjeeling in general is sold by estate, flush and year, with spring tea best drunk young. If a lot names B777, ask for the estate and flush as well.
description:
Bannockburn 777 is a planting clone approved for Darjeeling, not a tea you are likely to find on a shelf. It matters mainly to growers, and it is thinly documented for drinkers.

The Tea Board of India lists it among approved planting material for Darjeeling. A North Bengal University thesis classes it as a China hybrid.

Research on Darjeeling clones places it among the quality clones, with average yield. That is agronomy, not a tasting note: there is no dependable description of how it tastes in the cup, so brew it as you would any Darjeeling from the same flush.

If you see the name on a lot, treat it as a curiosity and judge the tea by its estate, flush and year.
history: Little is documented about this clone. Its name suggests a link with the Bannockburn garden, and it appears in the Tea Board's list of approved planting material and in academic work on Darjeeling clones. Who selected it and when is not recorded in any accessible account.
